phone_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "phone")
login_result = apis.phone.login(username='9503658964', password=phone_password)
print(login_result)

text_messages = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(
        access_token=login_result["access_token"],
        phone_number='9294880327',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20

    text_messages.extend(page)

    page_index += 1
